thread:
kevin: FYI I found two small but important migration surprises while updating the quickstart for v2. want to capture in a short note before the deprecation banner goes out.

maya: please share, worried about surprises for customers.

kevin: 1) embed alias swap: after swapping alias to rwd-embed-v2 some requests returned vectors of previous dim (1536) for a short window. verified on both hosted and dedicated.

oliver: sounds like a routing cache issue. did you capture a repro curl or SDK snippet?

kevin: yes, added to PR comment. minimal curl: 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2","input":"hi"}'
repeat a few times, sometimes returns len 1536.

maya: ok add a troubleshooting bullet and a tiny smoke-test script to the docs that asserts embedding.length === expected_dim. also tell Dedicated customers to run redwoodctl flush-alias-cache.

oliver: 2) SDK param rename: v1 used top_k, v2 uses candidate_count. SDK currently emits a console warning but the runtime ignores top_k silently. we should document current behavior and recommend migrating to candidate_count.

kevin: proposal: short migration checklist in doc: verify dims, flush cache, param rename table, run smoke test against canary subset.

maya: I'll add the checklist and a node+curl smoke test in PR #4601. will call out exact assertion and example JS snippet.

docs-ci-bot: PR 4601 opened by maya 1 lint/build queued.

oliver: add changelog note so SDK users get a heads up. might also include a small script devs can run in CI.

kevin: agreed. once PR merges we can update the deprecation banner copy with a one-line callout.

maya: will push changes today. assigning reviewers: @kevin, @oliver.

kevin: thanks, this will save users from an unpleasant surprise. :+1:
